payload.description_html:
Map of tyrannosauroid fossil localities as of December 2007. I used the blank political map of the world commonly used on Wikipedia ((BlankMap-World.png).
Keep in mind that the land masses would not have been in the same places they are today in the Jurassic and Cretaceous periods.
